annotations.title: Pages with search and visit figures

description: For one of the organization's connected websites, per page over a window of days: Search Console clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position, next to Analytics visits, visits from search and engagement rate, most clicked first, with the total number of pages. Search Console leaves out rare searches, so totals are lower than in Search Console. At most 366 days. A website that is not this organization's, not verified or not connected to Google answers not found. It changes nothing.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

limit.description: How many pages, most clicked first (default 50).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

name: webops_pages
